notes.title: v2.6
notes.notes:
- Modified some platforms
- Maps are now more "hidden"
- Small changes in some enemies

notes.title: v2.5
notes.notes:
- Added cursor sounds in diferent menues
- Added How To Play section in Main Menu
- Fixed a bug in throwing projectiles while running
- Fixed a visual bug when you quit a boss fight before it started
- Fixed a bug when you retain the current stage map and secret gem if you lose and continue

notes.title: v2.4
notes.notes:
- Changed the animation when throwing a projectile while running.
- Changes to fruits and enemies to ensure that it is possible to achieve Flawless Victory in all stages
- Modified position of the first axe of the stage so it is always possible to make Flawless Victory even if you start without a weapon
- The color of the falling platform has been changed

notes.title: V2.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with an enemy in Area 2 Round 4
- Fixed a visual glitch in background of Area 4
- Fixed the Skip/Change text in the ending not being visible
- Changed character hitbox during jumping

notes.title: Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the BGM muted after the ending
- Improved the jumping acceleration
- Improved Axe speed when oplayer is moving
- Other small fixes

notes.title: Buttons layout and some QoL changes
notes.notes:
V2.1 Changelog:
- Added Language selection when you first run the game (you can change it later in the options menu)
- Changed character running animation and his color palette
- Changed ending: Now you can read at your pace and change to next dialogue when you are ready
- Added diferent buttons layouts for joysticks and an alt layout for keyboard

notes.title: Added background variations
notes.notes:
You can now select whether you want to play during the day, at night, or at dusk/dawn.
You can also choose to play randomly or based on the system time.

notes.title: Added some QoL changes:
notes.notes:
V1.9
- Added turn while ducking
- Added Name of the button to activate potion in the UI
- Change UI buttons on real time when joystick is enable/disable
- Changed how the story is displayed, now you can read at your pace and go to next dialogue when pressing a button instead automaticly.
- Some changes in Options menu were made

notes.title: Added Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Added Leaderboards
Now you can store your best 10 times and scores of every level!

notes.title: Big change in weapons and more:
notes.notes:
- Added vertical movement to the Raven in Area 1.
- Changed an enemy in Area 4: The small flying tree is now a flying cat.
- Added axes to some levels, so you can now get it back at almost every checkpoint.

- Major weapon change:
Each weapon variation has different speeds.
Fire versions of weapons do double damage in Area 3.
Ice versions of weapons do double damage in Area 7.
You can throw weapons upward by holding UP.

notes.title: More Improvements and some fixes
notes.notes:
- Improved movement of the character.
He accelerate a bit slower and deaccelerate faster when you stop moving or change direction

- Fixed the after image effect in some enemies

- Improvement on how particles are managed in enemies

notes.title: More Fixes and QoL improvements
notes.notes:
- Fixed some strange bug in boss #1 where after some time it goes out of the screen
- Something similar with boss #4 and fixed the hitbox

Quality of Life change (QoL):
- Now if you pick the 10 gems of the level you got an extra life when you finish the round

notes.title: Fixed a strange bug and added more QoL changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the bug where after defeating the third boss the end of level portal was not visible.
- Added some red particles to background elements that are enemies, like cactus in Area 2
- Area 3 Fox speed changed

notes.title: Quality of Life Change
notes.notes: Now if you lose against a boss and continue, you strat from the boss instead of the start

notes.notes: Fixed the alignamet of the Snowman in Area 3
